products.title: Golden Retrievers Rink Board — Fitted Cap
products.description:

Flexfit 6277, a closed-back structured cap in a 63% polyester, 34% cotton and 3% spandex twill. Six-panel mid-profile crown, curved visor, silver undervisor, six embroidered eyelets, and a stretch band in place of a strap — so it sits like a fitted hat rather than a snapback. The mark is embroidered on the front panel in black, white and gold thread.

Two fitted sizes, S/M and L/XL, and between them they cover head circumferences of 22 to 23 7/8in (55.9 to 60.6 cm). Measure round your head just above the ears; there is give in the band either way.

Spot clean with cool water and let it air dry. A structured crown and a washing machine do not agree, and a dryer will take the shape out of it.

products.title: Golden Retrievers Heritage Seal — Sticker
products.description:
A round seal inside a double gold ring: GOLDEN arched over the top, RETRIEVERS around the foot, and the dog in three-quarter profile above a pair of crossed sticks.

Kiss-cut white vinyl with a glossy finish. The blade cuts the mark's own outline and leaves the backing sheet whole, so it peels away in one piece with no border to trim. Durable vinyl on a strong adhesive, but not waterproof — this is an indoor sticker for a laptop lid, a notebook or a locker door, not one for a bumper or a dishwasher.

Two sizes, 3" × 3" and 4" × 4". That measurement is the backing sheet: the sticker itself is cut to the outline of the mark inside it, so it sits a little smaller than the square.

Peel it off the sheet and press it onto a clean, dry, flat surface. Keep it out of the wash and off anything that gets soaked.

Sold in threes, and the three can be three different designs. One sticker costs more to post than it does to make, and three post for the same as one.

“Though she be but little, she is fierce.” — three inches of vinyl

sale.why: One sticker costs more to post ($4.59) than to make ($2.00), and free shipping on one would need an $11 price tag. Three post for $4.77. The three are three STICKERS and not three of one design: every sticker here is the same blueprint through the same maker, so postage merges across the designs as readily as across copies of one.
